description: Source code for the StableVideoDecoderFactoryService class, which manages creation and binding of video decoders using Mojo IPC in Chromium, including a MojoMediaClient implementation for platform-specific video decoder support.

classes.name: MojoMediaClientImpl
classes.description: Implementation of MojoMediaClient that provides supported video decoder configs and creates video decoders based on platform capabilities.

methods.name: GetSupportedVideoDecoderConfigs
methods.description: Returns supported video decoder configurations based on the decoder implementation type.

methods.name: GetDecoderImplementationType
methods.description: Determines the type of video decoder implementation (VAAPI, V4L2, or VDA).

methods.name: CreateVideoDecoder
methods.description: Creates a video decoder instance suitable for the platform and configuration.

methods.name: StableVideoDecoderFactoryService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service with GPU info and decoder preferences.

methods.name: BindReceiver
methods.description: Binds a Mojo receiver to the factory service.

methods.name: CreateStableVideoDecoder
methods.description: Creates and adds a new stable video decoder service to the managed collection.
